Internal: the note for a data folder just created

Source: R/options.R
dot-jst_data_dir_created_note.Rd

A folder named relative to the working directory keeps the sentence jsave() has always printed. An absolute path (a drive letter, a leading separator, or a leading tilde) is not "in working directory", and goes on a line of its own so that no wrap can break it.

Usage

.jst_data_dir_created_note(dir)

Arguments

dir

Character(1). The folder just created.

Value

Character(1), the note text.
